_help: Read by the UPI MDR Checker app and web page at launch. To publish a change: edit rules, raise version by 1, optionally set message (per language code, en is the fallback), then run npm test in the upi-mdr-app repo before pushing. effectiveDate is null while postponed, otherwise YYYY-MM-DD. Rates are fractions (0.004 = 0.4%).
